title: Infinity Machine: a self-improving AI agent for research
title_zh: 无限机器：一个自我改进的科研智能体

paragraphs.en: 自我改进科研智能体在量子信息与硬件设计中六天内取得多项超越SOTA的验证结果。 We present the Infinity Machine, a self-improving AI agent that we use for research on problems whose answers aprogram or data can check. Each candidate solution is produced by a full tool-using agent that works for up to an hour in a fresh sandbox; proposers see only a public score, and a private split decides what counts. The harness itself(prompts, tools, skills, playbook, meta agent) is an editable genome, changed only through a kernel-enforced gate with held-out and cost checks. An autonomous mode goes from a plain-text goal to a verified report with no human step: an agent picks an open problem and writes its verifier, the kernel calibrates it, an adversarial agent audits it, and an agent that never sees the verifier re-checks the result. Across fourteen problems in six days, for about $180 of model usage, the system produced four results beyond the published state of the art on catalogued open problems in quantum information: a certified depolarizing-channel threshold point p = 0.064966, a qutrit positivity frontier of 0.2910672, a 44-gate depth-6 Golay state preparation, and a stabilizer-rank bound chi(T^7) <= 10. It also cut SABRE qubit-routing overhead from 68,559 to 12,087 added gates. In hardware, it cut the energy per MAC of an open 8x8 INT8 systolic tile by 77.7% through a full open RTL-to-GDS flow, bit-exact. Three fully autonomous runs ended in honestties with public records; one audit caught a stale record, and one agent-written score pointing the wrong way went unnoticed. We report the failures as carefully: the one self-derived harness generation was rejected on cost, proposers gamed lenient scorers four times, and operator changes were decisive for several results.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进的科研智能体在量子信息与硬件设计中于六天内取得多项超越SOTA的验证结果。我们提出Infinity Machine，这是一个自我改进的AI智能体，用于研究那些答案可由程序或数据验证的问题。 每个候选解都由一个完整的、会使用工具的智能体生成，该智能体在一个全新的沙箱中工作长达一小时；提议者只能看到公开分数，而由私有数据划分来决定什么算数。 测试框架本身（提示词、工具、技能、行动手册、元智能体）是一个可编辑的基因组，只能通过内核强制的门控进行修改，门控包含留出集检查与成本检查。 自主模式可以从纯文本目标直接生成经验证的报告，无需任何人工环节：一个智能体选择一个开放问题并编写其验证器，内核对其进行校准，一个对抗性智能体对其进行审计，再由一个从未见过验证器的智能体重新核验结果。 在六天内针对十四个问题、花费约180美元的模型使用费用，该系统在量子信息领域的已编目开放问题上取得了四项超越已发表最优水平的结果：一个经过认证的去极化信道阈值点 p = 0.064966、一个qutrit正定性边界 0.2910672、一个44门深度为6的Golay态制备，以及一个稳定子秩界 chi(T^7) <= 10。 它还将SABRE量子比特路由的开销从新增68,559个门降至12,087个门。 在硬件方面，它通过完整的开源RTL到GDS流程（位级精确），将一个开源8x8 INT8脉动阵列的每次乘累加（MAC）能耗降低了77.7%。 三次完全自主的运行最终与公开纪录打成平手；一次审计发现了一条过时的纪录，还有一个指向错误方向的智能体编写的评分未被察觉。 我们同样认真地报告失败之处：唯一一次自我衍生的测试框架生成因成本原因被拒绝，提议者四次钻了宽松评分器的空子，而操作者的干预对若干结果起了决定性作用。
